name: Shared UI Components
description: Reusable presentational React components used across all pages of the exemplar.tools documentation website. Barrel-exported collection of four components: CodeBlock (preformatted CLI commands with copy-to-clipboard), VersionBadge (inline component name + version badge), YouTubeEmbed (responsive YouTube iframe wrapper), and CalloutBox (variant-styled container for gotchas, warnings, and tips). All components use strict TypeScript annotations, named exports only (no defaults), and are tested with vitest + @testing-library/react. Mock surface: consumers mocking this module must provide exactly four runtime exports: { CodeBlock, VersionBadge, YouTubeEmbed, CalloutBox }.

functions.name: CodeBlock
functions.description: React functional component that renders a preformatted CLI command or code snippet inside <pre><code> with syntax styling via Tailwind CSS and a copy-to-clipboard button. The copy button invokes navigator.clipboard.writeText(code) on click. File: src/components/shared/CodeBlock.tsx. Named export only.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing the code string and optional description

error_cases.name: clipboard_unavailable
error_cases.condition: navigator.clipboard is undefined (e.g. non-HTTPS context or older browser)

error_data.behavior: Copy button should degrade gracefully — either hide the button or show a fallback tooltip. Must not throw an unhandled exception.
The promise rejection must be caught. Component may show a brief error state on the button but must not propagate the error to the React error boundary.

preconditions: Component is rendered within a React 18 tree
postconditions: Returns a <pre> element containing a <code> element with the code text
A copy button element is present as a sibling or child of the <pre>
If props.description is provided and non-empty, a descriptive label element is rendered above or within the block
If props.description is omitted or empty, no description element is rendered
Clicking the copy button calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with props.code

structured_side_effects.description: Writes props.code to system clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText when copy button is clicked

functions.name: VersionBadge
functions.description: React functional component that renders a styled inline badge displaying a component name and version string. Uses Tailwind CSS for pill/badge styling. File: src/components/shared/VersionBadge.tsx. Named export only.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing componentName and version strings

preconditions: Component is rendered within a React 18 tree
postconditions: Returns an inline element (e.g. <span>) with badge styling
The rendered text contains both props.componentName and props.version
The element uses Tailwind classes for pill/badge appearance (rounded, background color, padding)

structured_side_effects.description: Pure presentational component with no side effects

functions.name: YouTubeEmbed
functions.description: React functional component that renders a responsive iframe wrapper for YouTube videos. Converts standard YouTube watch URLs (youtube.com/watch?v=ID) and short URLs (youtu.be/ID) to embed format (youtube.com/embed/ID). Uses Tailwind 'aspect-video' class on a wrapper div for responsive sizing. File: src/components/shared/YouTubeEmbed.tsx. Named export only.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing the YouTube URL and optional title

error_cases.name: invalid_youtube_url
error_cases.condition: props.url does not match expected YouTube URL patterns and video ID cannot be extracted

error_data.behavior: Component renders a fallback element (e.g. a styled <div> with error text) instead of a broken iframe. Must not throw during render.

preconditions: props.url is a valid YouTube watch URL or youtu.be short URL
Component is rendered within a React 18 tree
postconditions: Returns a wrapper <div> with Tailwind 'aspect-video' class for responsive sizing
Contains an <iframe> element whose src is 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId}' derived from props.url
The iframe has title attribute set to props.title (or 'YouTube video' if omitted)
The iframe has allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture' and allowFullScreen
The iframe has frameBorder='0' and width='100%' height='100%'

structured_side_effects.description: The rendered iframe triggers a network request to YouTube's embed endpoint when mounted in the browser. The component itself does not make the request — the browser does via the iframe src.

functions.name: CalloutBox
functions.description: React functional component that renders a styled container for gotchas, warnings, and tips. Uses a variant prop (gotcha | warning | tip) to select from a Record<CalloutVariant, string> mapping of Tailwind CSS class strings, producing distinct visual styling per variant. File: src/components/shared/CalloutBox.tsx. Named export only.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing the variant discriminator and text content

preconditions: Component is rendered within a React 18 tree
postconditions: Returns a container <div> (or <aside>) with variant-specific Tailwind classes applied
The 'gotcha' variant renders with distinct border/background classes (e.g. red/orange tones)
The 'warning' variant renders with distinct border/background classes (e.g. yellow/amber tones)
The 'tip' variant renders with distinct border/background classes (e.g. green/teal tones)
All three variants produce visually distinguishable containers (different class strings)
props.text is rendered as visible text content within the container
The container includes a role='alert' or appropriate ARIA attribute for accessibility

structured_side_effects.description: Pure presentational component with no side effects

functions.name: extractYouTubeVideoId
functions.description: Internal utility function that extracts the 11-character YouTube video ID from a watch URL or short URL. Used by YouTubeEmbed to construct the embed src. Not exported from the barrel — internal to YouTubeEmbed.tsx or a shared utility.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: A YouTube URL string to extract the video ID from

error_cases.name: no_video_id_found
error_cases.condition: URL does not contain a recognizable YouTube video ID pattern

postconditions: If url matches youtube.com/watch?v={id}, returns the 11-character video ID
If url matches youtu.be/{id}, returns the 11-character video ID
If url does not match either pattern, returns an empty string

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function — string parsing only, no side effects

invariants: All four components (CodeBlock, VersionBadge, YouTubeEmbed, CalloutBox) are named exports from the barrel index.ts — no default exports anywhere
All five type exports (CalloutVariant, CodeBlockProps, VersionBadgeProps, YouTubeEmbedProps, CalloutBoxProps) are exported via 'export type { }' syntax from the barrel
The barrel file (index.ts) re-exports all runtime and type exports from individual component files and types.ts
File structure: src/components/shared/{CodeBlock.tsx, VersionBadge.tsx, YouTubeEmbed.tsx, CalloutBox.tsx, types.ts, index.ts}
Each component file has a corresponding .test.tsx file using vitest + @testing-library/react
Consumers mocking this module via vi.mock() must provide exactly { CodeBlock, VersionBadge, YouTubeEmbed, CalloutBox } — all four runtime exports
CalloutBox internally uses a Record<CalloutVariant, string> mapping to assign distinct Tailwind class strings per variant
YouTubeEmbed wrapper div always has the Tailwind 'aspect-video' class for responsive sizing
CodeBlock copy button calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code) and handles both unavailable clipboard API and rejected promise gracefully
All components are pure presentational — no internal state management beyond transient UI state (e.g. copy button feedback)
All public function signatures have explicit TypeScript type annotations per project standards

data_access.rationale: Shared UI components are purely presentational and receive all data via props. They read only PUBLIC-tier data: code snippets for display (CodeBlock), version strings (VersionBadge), YouTube video URLs (YouTubeEmbed), and callout text content (CalloutBox). No PII, INTERNAL, or sensitive data is accessed. No data is written to any persistent store.

side_effects.rationale: CodeBlock copies the code prop (a CLI command string, PUBLIC data) to the system clipboard when the user clicks the copy button via navigator.clipboard.writeText
YouTubeEmbed renders an iframe whose src points to youtube.com/embed/{videoId}, causing the browser to fetch the YouTube embed page. The URL is PUBLIC documentation content.
